plan.question: At equal latent coefficient count, how do structured CSA and unrestricted vector PCA differ in training reconstruction, held-out reconstruction and 1-NN recognition as sample size changes?
plan.scope: 2D CSA pedagogical implementation on downsampled MNIST; not a replication of the paper's face/USPS/Gabor tables
plan.initialization: leading row/column covariance eigenvectors; one deterministic start
plan.pca_dimension: r*r, skip comparison if r*r > min(n_train-1,196)
plan.selection: No hyperparameter/model selection on test; all listed settings reported
metrics: basis coefficient count excluding shared mean
captured energy after every coordinate update
checks: PCA training MSE <= CSA at matched latent dimension
plan.limitations: Three nested training subset seeds with a shared fixed stratified test set. Sample SD is not a confidence interval. Labels only select stratified samples and 1NN reference labels, never fit CSA/PCA. No universal superiority or global-optimum claim. Timing is single host, not an asymptotic proof.
